Definition: neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of G868; properly, something separative, i.e. (specially) divorce:--(writing of) divorcement.
BiblicalUsage: This is the certificate of divorce, the writing a man gave a woman to send her away. Jesus quotes the old permission in Matthew 5:31 and again in Matthew 19:7, and the Pharisees press Him on it in Mark 10:4. The paper made the break legal, but Jesus pushes past the paper to the hardness of heart behind it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a legal paper never settles what God thinks of a marriage. Jesus treats divorce as a concession to hard hearts, not as God's design, and He points us back to what God joined together from the beginning.
